name: Microphones
summary: Microphones that turn sound into a signal: electret capsules, dynamic mics and MEMS chips.
identify: Tiny round metal capsules (electret, 6–10 mm) with two wires in phones, headsets, toys, cameras and baby monitors; dynamic mics in CB radios, PA systems and karaoke gear.
test: Electret mics need a small bias voltage (2–10V through a resistor); tap them and watch the signal on a meter or amp. Dynamic mics: plug into any amp and speak.
